# Phone Comparison

> Compare phones side by side: real specs, prices by storage and linked expert reviews for 40 phones from 12 brands.

- [Phone Comparison](https://mobile-comparison.vercel.app/): homepage, compare 2 or 3 phones
- [All brands](https://mobile-comparison.vercel.app/brands/)
- [iPhone vs Samsung](https://mobile-comparison.vercel.app/compare/iphone-vs-samsung.html)
- [iPhone vs Android](https://mobile-comparison.vercel.app/compare/iphone-vs-android.html)
